_: A town dressed in what we own (dressing.gd; art targets docs/art/target/01-town and town-composition/town-b; docs/research/free-rts-kits.md: use more of the Quaternius Fantasy Props, Village and Stylized Nature MegaKits). on: the switch (or --dressing=on / --dressing=off). kits: where each kit's models are (%s the model's name) and the metres-to-world scale. trades.<trade>: what stands at that trade's building, each [kit/model, along (metres along its front, + to its right as you face it), out (metres out from its middle toward the street; the front wall is at about half the building's depth), turn (degrees), scale]. A thing is set down only where it blocks nothing: off every building, wall and stall (footprints), clear of every door (door), of the main streets (street) and back lanes (lane) from their middle, and of every work spot people stand at (spot), all in world units. homes: at a house's door, planters and flower boxes against its front, either side of the door ([kit/model, along, out, turn, scale], the door's own middle at along 0), by chance by rank. ground: between the houses, so the trodden ground isn't bare: tries a town by rank, each a pick from pick ([kit/model, weight, [smallest, largest] scale]), set down only where it blocks nothing, and kept apart (gap, world units). square_edge: along the inside of the square's rim (ring: a share of its radius, square_r), tries by rank, what stands there (benches face the heart; barrels, crates, potted shrubs and flower tubs), kept gap apart, clear of the stalls' fronts (stall_clear past each stall's half-width) and the centrepiece's basin (centre_clear past its rim), and of doors and road mouths as everything is. rank: towns by rank (crown, seat, town, village) take this share of ground tries and homes' planters. Each model is drawn as one batch per town. underfoot: models people walk over (flowers, pebbles, clover); everything else is ground nobody walks through (it joins the town's footprints, the walk map).
